data.name: An excluded server is not exported, even when all servers are selected or both boxes are checked.

data.name: Configure the ClickHouse connection and retention in the MetricsExport section of appsettings.json or environment variables. Export selection is saved separately from AlertCenter monitoring and does not store credentials.
data.value: Configure the ClickHouse connection and retention in the MetricsExport section of appsettings.json or environment variables. Export selection is saved separately from AlertCenter monitoring and does not store credentials.

data.value: Every server is exported unless explicitly excluded. Newly connected servers are included automatically.

data.name: Excluded servers always take precedence. When all servers are exported, individual inclusions are unnecessary.
data.value: Excluded servers always take precedence. When all servers are exported, individual inclusions are unnecessary.

data.name: Export all servers, including newly connected servers
data.value: Export all servers, including newly connected servers

data.name: No server is exported. Your include and exclude selections remain saved for when you enable the policy again.
data.value: No server is exported. Your include and exclude selections remain saved for when you enable the policy again.

data.name: Policies and selections survive a restart. Servers without a new report remain listed by ClientId when they have a saved selection. Raw samples are still exported in five-minute batches, and live monitoring and AlertCenter rules are unchanged.
data.value: Policies and selections survive a restart. Servers without a new report remain listed by ClientId when they have a saved selection. Raw samples are still exported in five-minute batches, and live monitoring and AlertCenter rules are unchanged.

data.name: Saving applies the selection to new samples and removes excluded samples still waiting in memory. An already running ClickHouse write may finish before saving completes. Previously stored history is kept.
data.value: Saving applies the selection to new samples and removes excluded samples still waiting in memory. An already running ClickHouse write may finish before saving completes. Previously stored history is kept.

data.value: Server selection follows the same include and exclude rules as AlertCenter monitoring, with an independent policy.
